what: Python terminal stalls are written to finalize-state but the proposed plan leaves ship-pr-state stall keys stale and the stall classifier ignores finalize-state
scenario_or_breakage: On a default Python STALLED outcome, Step 18a may see finalize-state STALL_TRACKING=true, but classification still reads only ship-pr-state/session-env; with preserved STALL_TRACKING=false it can classify as unrecoverable or skip recovery instead of resuming step8-shippr
suggested_fix: Add one minimal contract: either have Python terminal state writes update ship-pr-state STALL_TRACKING/STALL_STEP/EXIT_CODE for terminal stalls, or teach stall-recovery-report.sh and stall-recovery.md to read finalize-state as the same fourth stall layer; add a focused py/shell test for a Python stall with finalize-state true and ship-pr-state false.
